notes.title: Community Update: A New Year!
notes.notes:
🎮 Community Update: A new year! 🌟

Lovely Fae & Fauna community,

As we kick off 2024, we're thrilled to share some highlights and insights into what's been brewing behind the scenes:

🎬Looking back at 2023
2023 was the year our studio was born, and we grew from tiny seedlings to bigger, more experienced plants. Through the support of our community, our incubator and fellow game devs, this journey has been a blast. We forged friendships, made important insight and got to discuss our ideas over pizza and a hefty amount of cake. 

🛠️ What Are the Devs Doing?
Our small team of devs have been hard at work, refining our pipeline and deciding on some big changes for us as a studio and for the project. Therefore we’re happy to say…

🌟 We’ve made the switch to Unreal 5!
Yes, you heard it right! We're making the leap to Unreal Engine 5. This move allows us to take advantage of the tech and more possibilities within this engine. We’re ready to take this game to the next level and want to deliver something beautiful and sustainable. In the coming months ahead, we’re thrilled to show our progress and this new version of Fae & Fauna. 

Thank you for being an essential part of the Fae & Fauna community. Your passion fuels our creativity, and we can't wait to share more incredible moments with you in the coming months. Stay tuned for further updates, and let's make 2024 an unforgettable gaming year!

Digital hugs and platonic kisses,
The Fae & Fauna Dev Team 🎮✨
